sn19.9:1.9: _Sūcaka_ appears only here in Pali, his title echoing his punishment by needles (_sūci_) which worm their way in and out of his body like he wormed his way through society. He was an “informant” (Arthaśāstra 2.8.29), whose punishment was to be reborn with a stinking nose (Manu 11.50). As noted in the next Sutta, the informant reported to the “village head”.
